title: Rockstar Is Throwing a Real GTA 6 Festival in Miami: Travis Scott, Cardi B and How to Get In 🎤 #Shorts
description:
Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival, Nov 21 at Mana Wynwood in Miami, presented by Rockstar Games and PlayStation. Lineup includes Travis Scott, Cardi B, Metro Boomin, Tainy and a Justice DJ set. Tickets via lottery (entries close Nov 10, 4 PM ET), 17+.
Source: rockstargames.com/VI/gtavi-thefestival
